text:
Situation: Chloroprocaine hydrochloride has been on FDA's shortage list since 2021-05-17 and as of 2026-10-21 the shortage has been on FDA's list for 65 months. Corvale East holds 30 vials of the 20 mg/mL 20 mL presentation (NDC 00143920910, labeled by Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., manufactured at HIKMA FARMACÊUTICA (PORTUGAL)) with 8.1 days on hand. Corvale General holds 64 vials of the same strength and size with 15 days on hand, plus 65 vials of 10 mg/mL with 14.5 days. Corvale Lakeside holds 13 vials of 20 mg/mL 20 mL with 18 days and 8 vials of 10 mg/mL 30 mL with 11 days.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1123748 at Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC ended 2020-05-18 and was classified OAI with a classification letter dated 2024-05-22. A second FDA inspection 1174894 at the same facility ended 2022-06-30 and was classified OAI with a classification letter dated 2024-04-30.

Our position: Corvale East is below the two-week target. Corvale Lakeside and Corvale General each have sufficient 20 mg/mL 20 mL stock to support a limited transfer while maintaining at least 14 days on hand. Alternate suppliers and concentration changes are available but secondary.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 2 vials of 20 mg/mL 20 mL from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director transfer request.
2. If Option 1 cannot be executed, transfer 4 vials of 20 mg/mL 20 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director transfer request.
3. If transfers are not feasible, purchase from HF Acquisition Co LLC (DBA HealthFirst) — requires buyer.
4. If purchase from HealthFirst is not feasible, purchase from ProPharma Distribution — requires buyer.
5. If supply cannot be secured above, use alternate concentration (10 mg/mL) from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. with pharmacist verification — requires pharmacist.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or protocol modifications; those are for the treating clinicians and the committee.
